All Regional P.F. Commissioner-Incharge of
Regional/Sub-Regional Offices

Subject: Implementation of CCPAP Module of Payment.

Sir/Madam,

The CCPAP Module for payment in A/c No. 1 & 10 has been implemented successfully
by all field offices except RO, Delhi(North), SRO, Bathinda & SRO Siliguri.

2. RPFCs are, therefore, advised to ensure uploading of digitally signed file of CCPAP to
SBI SFTP Server on a daily basis. APFC (Cash) may ensure that files are simultaneously
uploaded in respect of cheques issued in A/c No. 1 & 10. The responsibility of prompt
uploading of files shall lie with APFC (Cash). RPFC-II (F&A) posted in Regional Offices &
RPFC-II of Sub-Regional Offices shall ensure that the cheques issued during the day are
uploaded through CCPAP file at the end of the day. For this, a_ fink
“http://banking.epfoservices.org/CCPAP/” has been provided for monitoring the status of
CCPAP.

3. Further, after implementation of CCPAP, the limit prescribed vide this office circular
letter no, Bkg/Fraud/05/15614 dated 24/11/2011 (Posted at SI. No. 408 of 2011-12 on EPFO
website) for drawing cheques for maximum of Rs. 1 lac in A/c no. 1 and Rs. 50,000/- in A/c
no. 10 would cease to be in force. Hence, all cheques irrespective of any amount may be
issued from A/c no. 1 & 10 through CCPAP.

, Yours faithfully,
A

{Sanjay Kumar)

Financial Advisor & Chief Accounts Officer
